assertions_passed: metadata sorted by explicit IDs, correct split labels
control expression arrays match train/val control rows exactly

metric_definition.delta_rmse: per-case sqrt(mean_g((pred_delta-(true_treated_mean-observed_matched_control_mean))^2)); mean within each drug, then across drugs
metric_definition.delta_pearson: Pearson across same 2000 genes; constant/zero prediction -> NaN; report coverage, never treat undefined as0 or compare dropped subsets without qualification
metric_definition.top100: 100 genes with largest absolute true mean delta, not statistical DE test
metric_definition.absolute_r2: 1-sum_g((pred_abs-y)^2)/sum_g((y-mean_g(y))^2), across genes per case; pred_abs anchor must be declared

anchor_options: native model treated mean - observed matched control mean
model treated mean - model control mean, added to observed matched control mean for residual-calibrated absolute estimate; explicit adapter, report separately
data_boundary: Model training uses prepared.npz and ID-mapped metadata train/val only. Prediction may condition on all per-case matched zero-dose controls, including validation controls already allowed to LEXA; these do not become fitting data. Treated 5uM targets are scorer-only.
information_limitation: CPA/CODEX learn numerical drug-dose responses from train; pure-mechanism DeepSeek has no response retrieval at inference. Same permitted dataset and test does not imply identical supervision or evidence inputs.
